en.name: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4060 8GB
en.shortDescription: 8GB graphics card for 1080p/1440p gaming with DLSS 3 support.
en.description:
## NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4060 8GB

An efficient graphics card for smooth 1080p and 1440p gaming, with DLSS 3 frame generation for a big performance boost.

- 8 GB GDDR6 memory
- PCIe 4.0 interface
- Ray tracing and DLSS 3 support

Kaadhka sawirka ah oo tamar yar isticmaala, loogu talagalay ciyaaraha 1080p iyo 1440p oo si fiican u socda, leh DLSS 3 oo kordhisa waxqabadka si weyn.

- Interface PCIe 4.0 ah
- Taageerta ray tracing iyo DLSS 3
